system.description: The Stormkelt screams out a summons, and Tyrd answers with a booming t hunderclap that spurs the dimwalker or one of their allies to greater battle morale, while shattering the morale of their enemies. The war cry grants the target within range +3 on all combat actions for the duration. One of the dimwalker’s enemies within range also receives -3 on all combat actions for the duration.
system.summary: The Stormkelt screams out a summons, and Tyrd answers with a booming thunderclap that spurs the dimwalker or one of their allies to greater battle morale, while shattering the morale of their enemies.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the number of allies who are affected by the ability by +1 (maximum 6)
Increase the duration by 1 action round
Increase the bonus on combat actions by another +1 (maximum 6)
